summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, added a CHANGELOG entry, and updated tests/test_progress.py. TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed and a static render_speed; track() gained show_speed (default True); Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total. The ValueError assertions were removed and test_task_progress_column_speed was added. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black) and nothing was committed. Removing the ValueError blocks also means the tests no longer iterate track(5) at all.
